title: Artificial Intelligence Company initiative (draft proposal)
last_action: A congressional oversight letter publicly described the developing Artificial Intelligence Company proposal; no bill had yet been introduced.
status: Draft proposal under development; not introduced
summary: Delaware officials are developing a framework for an Artificial Intelligence Company whose AI agent could perform day-to-day corporate operations, potentially with new governance and liability rules. The proposal is not yet introduced legislation.
committee_dynamics: The initiative grows out of Delaware's agentic-AI regulatory-sandbox work under H.J.R. 7. Because no bill text has been introduced, its final governance, transparency, liability, and safety provisions remain uncertain.
advance_rationale: The proposal has official state-policy groundwork but no introduced bill text or formal legislative pathway yet.
verification_level: Official sources confirm the initiative and precursor work; bill text has not been introduced
